checks_run.procedure: Portability probe and reproduction of new finding F-DG0-224. Clone the candidate under a path containing spaces ('qa9 space dir/My Projects/repo') and under an Arabic path ('qa9-مستخدم/repo'). Run the gate and guard tests, prefreeze and every validator mode, locate the root cause, and confirm the failure mode is fail-closed (a crash or non-zero exit, never a false PASS).
checks_run.command: node --test tools/gates/tests/*.test.mjs tools/agents/tests/*.test.mjs; bash tools/gates/prefreeze.sh DG0; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG0|--pipeline|--reconcile; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0
checks_run.environment: disposable clones at cbc755d under a space path and an Arabic path; node v22.22.2
checks_run.expected: Reproduction check: the defect reproduces deterministically, its root cause is identified, and the failure is fail-closed. The portability goal itself (tooling runs from any checkout location) is NOT expected to hold. It is the subject of F-DG0-224.
checks_run.actual: Reproduced. The portability goal is NOT met. Space path: 36/53 tests fail and prefreeze exits 1. Under both paths --pipeline and --reconcile crash with uncaught ENOENT on '...%20.../tools/gates/schemas/stages.schema.json' (exit 1); --register and candidate.mjs pass. Root cause: tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs:37 `new URL('.', import.meta.url).pathname` stays percent-encoded. Same line in d662625, introduced in 8825dca. Every failure is a crash with non-zero exit, so it fails closed with no false PASS and no integrity impact. Recorded as F-DG0-224 (Low, non-mandatory, acceptable as an observation). This check is PASS only as a reproduction; the defect itself is open.

summary: PASS on candidate fc0bd2a2 (cbc755d). Every required command passes in disposable clones: extraction, gate tests 40/40, guard tests 13/13, run_meta tests 5/5, register, pipeline, reconcile, candidate ID, and prefreeze on a fresh clone. The register (411 rows, 0 VERIFIED, exact coverage matrices) passes with 0 errors, as do all 19 DG0 rows' evidence content, the ten-agent load evidence, the agents.md claims, A01-A28 feasibility and the live guard probe. F-DG0-223 is reproduced on d662625 and fixed on cbc755d: CLOSED_VERIFIED, with 7 new QA9 regex cases showing the binding wasn't loosened. New F-DG0-224 (Low, non-mandatory, acceptable as an observation): rules.mjs:37 uses URL.pathname, so the validator crashes (fail closed) when the checkout path contains a space or non-ASCII characters. This environment and CI are unaffected. QA9-K09 (the portability probe) and the one failing QA9 case are reproductions of this Low finding.
